notes: The opening أبی ره is the compiler's father, named only by relation (relation kind). The Imam أبی عبد الله stands inside the chain after عن, so he stays a narrator (ruling 2). The remark on Muhammad b. Yahya's wording is a pure wording variant and is left out. The question قلت ما معنى inside the saying has no named asker and is not added.
